summary:
Chartered Accountant with strong academic performance including 5 exemptions in CA Final, and professional experience in statutory audit,
SOX / ICFR controls testing, and financial reporting within consulting and financial services environments. Skilled in Risk & Control Matrix (RCM)
documentation, risk assessment, analytical review, and evaluation of internal financial controls across R2R, P2P and O2C cycles under Ind AS /
IFRS frameworks. Experienced in supporting audit engagements, financial statement reviews, and coordinating with global teams to strengthen
internal control environments and ensure regulatory compliance.

pre_date_header: Genpact India Private Limited | Management Trainee
bullets: – Facilitated process walkthroughs and documentation of Risk & Control Matrices (RCM) for key financial cycles including R2R, P2P and O2C. – Supported SOX / ICFR control testing, including documentation of Design and Operating Effectiveness (DOE) and evaluation of Internal Financial Controls (IFC). – Contributed to financial reporting risk assessments and assisted in identification and remediation tracking of control deficiencies. – Coordinated with US onshore audit teams during audit cycles by providing audit evidence, reconciliations and financial reporting schedules. – Performed analytical review procedures, account reconciliations and variance analysis to enhance reporting accuracy under IFRS and Ind AS frameworks. – Assisted in preparation of financial reporting schedules and supported financial statement review during statutory and compliance audits.

pre_date_header: ICICI Home Finance Company Limited | Deputy Manager
bullets: – Conducted detailed credit risk evaluations to determine loan eligibility under AS & Ind AS frameworks – Identified early warning signals and applied risk mitigation strategies, including collateral evaluation and personal discussions with borrowers. – Ensured compliance with internal credit policy, RBI norms, SOX control and audit requirements to maintain portfolio quality.
